Dholuo: Jatelono nojiwo migawo ma dinde nigo mar tiyo gi pesago e konyo joma odak e pinje mamoko, kendo nojiwo Jo-Kenya modak e pinje mamoko mondo odonj e ofisgi man machiegni gi Kenya, kojiwo ni misonari e okang' mokwongo mar tudruok e kind pinyno gi joma odak e pinje mamoko.

English: Anyone who witnesses child abuse during fire disasters should alert authorities immediately.
Kiswahili: Yeyote anayeshuhudia unyanyasaji wa watoto wakati wa majanga ya moto anapaswa kuarifu mamlaka mara moja.
Dholuo: Ng'at ang'ata ma neno ka itimo ne nyathi timbe marach e kinde ma masira mag mach timore, onego onyis jotelo mapiyo.

English: Unauthorized livestock movement spreads disease. Farmers should demand permits and follow quarantine notices.
Kiswahili: Uhamaji usioidhinishwa wa mifugo hueneza magonjwa. Wakulima wanapaswa kudai vibali na kufuata notisi za karantini.
Dholuo: Wuotho kata kwayo jamni maonge chenro maler miyo tuoche landore, omiyo jopur onego okwa rusa kendo giluw chike mag bedo e karantin.

English: Loving a Drug User or Alcoholic.
Kiswahili: Kumpenda Mtumia Madawa ya Kulevya au Mlevi.
Dholuo: Hero Ng'at ma Tiyo gi Yath Kata Madho Kong'o.

English: In light of recent vandalism of public property cases, residents are reminded to follow road safety guidelines.
Kiswahili: Kutokana na visa vya hivi karibuni vya uharibifu wa mali ya umma, wakazi wanakumbushwa kufuata miongozo ya usalama barabarani.
Dholuo: Kaluwore gi kes mag ketho mwandu mag piny ma osetimore machiegni, iparo ne jodak mondo oluw chike mag rito yore.

English: Report economic crimes and procurement fraud to demonstrate community commitment to justice.
Kiswahili: Ripoti uhalifu wa kiuchumi na ulaghai wa ununuzi ili kuonyesha kujitolea kwa jamii kwa haki.
Dholuo: Riw ripot mar ketho mag yuto kod wuondruok e weche mag yuto mondo onyis ni oganda ogeno ahinya weche makare.

English: Differentiate your free-range eggs in the market by creating a strong brand identity. Learn basic branding principles and marketing techniques.
Kiswahili: Tofautisha mayai yako ya biashara huria sokoni kwa kuunda utambulisho imara wa chapa. Jifunze kanuni za msingi za chapa na mbinu za uuzaji.
Dholuo: Ti gi ranyisi mar ng'ato mondo ilosgo tong' ma in-go e chiro, puonjri weche motudore gi keto tong' kod yore mag uso tong'.

English: Teachers recommend combining responsible internet use with regular attendance to address lack of learning materials.
Kiswahili: Walimu wanapendekeza kuchanganya matumizi ya kuwajibika ya intaneti na mahudhurio ya mara kwa mara kushughulikia ukosefu wa vifaa vya kujifunzia.
Dholuo: Jopuonj golo paro ni mondo oriw tiyo kod mbui maber kod bedo e chokruoge kinde ka kinde mondo ilos bedo maonge gi gige somo.

English: NSSF alerts contributors to disregard WhatsApp messages claiming there is a special withdrawal window for those over 40. No such provision exists.
Kiswahili: NSSF yawatahadharisha wachangiaji kupuuza jumbe za WhatsApp wakidai kuna dirisha maalum la kujiondoa kwa wale walio na umri wa zaidi ya miaka 40. Hakuna kifungu kama hicho kilichopo.
Dholuo: NSSF okwedo ote miore hatsApp ka giwacho ni nitie thuolo makende mar weyo solro ni jogo ma hikgi oloyo 40.

English: Ministry of Interior calls upon citizens to contribute their views on to strengthen governance.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Mambo ya Ndani inatoa wito kwa raia kutoa maoni yao kuhusu kuimarisha utawala.
Dholuo: Apis mar weche mag arita kwayo raia mondo ochiw pachgi kuom wach gero sirkal.

English: In addition, the outbreak is affecting the densely populated capital city Nairobi, and two large refugee camps (Kakuma and Dadaab) with massive population movements within country and between neighbouring countries.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuongeza, mlipuko huo unaathiri mji mkuu wa Nairobi wenye wakazi wengi, na kambi mbili kubwa za wakimbizi (Kakuma na Dadaab) zenye harakati kubwa za watu ndani ya nchi na kati ya nchi jirani.
Dholuo: Kaachiel gi mago, loch ni mulo boma maduong' mar Nairobi ma nigi oganda mang'eny, kod kambi ariyo madongo mag jolweny (Kakuma kod Dadaab) mantie gi wuodh mathoth mar oganda ei piny kod e kind pinje man machiegni.

English: Kindly proceed to apply for a duplicate logbook from your account. Please reach out if your require any more information.
Kiswahili: Tafadhali endelea kutuma maombi ya kitabu cha kumbukumbu kutoka kwa akaunti yako. Tafadhali wasiliana nasi ikiwa unahitaji maelezo zaidi.
Dholuo: Ka diher ng'eyo weche momedore, inyalo dhi nyime kwayo mondo okonyi yudo kopi ariyo mag bugno mar mtoka.

English: A total of 124 cases tested positive for Vibrio cholerae in the reference laboratory.
Kiswahili: Jumla ya visa 124 vilipatikana na Vibrio cholerae katika maabara ya kumbukumbu.
Dholuo: 124 ma ne oyudre gi tuo mar kolera e kar ranyisi ma ne itiyogo.

English: Join public participation forums this month to learn how to access tax compliance certificates and report nepotism in hiring.
Kiswahili: Jiunge na mabaraza ya ushiriki wa umma mwezi huu kujifunza jinsi ya kupata vyeti vya ufuasi wa kodi na kuripoti upendeleo katika uajiri.
Dholuo: Idonji e chokruoge mag ji duto dwe ni mondo ing'e kaka inyalo yud oboke mag luwo osuru kendo igolo ripot mar ng'anjo e kepo.

English: Build dormitories for boarding schools 2022.
Kiswahili: Jenga mabweni ya shule za bweni 2022.
Dholuo: Gero ute mag nindo ne skunde ma nigi boarding e higa 2022.

English: Include all! Provide ramps and resources for disabled students.
Kiswahili: Jumuisha yote! Toa njia na rasilimali kwa wanafunzi walemavu.
Dholuo: Winjuru ji duto! Chiw kuonde mag wuoth kod gige konyo jopuonjre ma nigi midekre.

English: EACC builds local watchdog groups to fight bribery in counties.
Kiswahili: EACC hujenga vikundi vya walinzi wa ndani ili kupambana na rushwa katika kaunti.
Dholuo: EACC loso grube mag jorit e alwora mondo oked gi mibadhi e counties.

English: Act now! Communities, prevent FGM to protect girls.
Kiswahili: Chukua hatua sasa! Jamii, zuia ukeketaji ili kuwalinda wasichana.
Dholuo: Kaw okang' sani! jodak duto, geng'uru nyang'e mar joma nyiri mondo uritgi.

English: The cost of targeted testing for Covid-19 and government quarantine facilities shall be met by the government effective today. Kenyans should not be afraid to get tested
Kiswahili: Gharama ya upimaji unaolengwa wa Covid-19 na vituo vya karantini vya serikali italipwa na serikali kuanzia leo. Wakenya hawapaswi kuogopa kupimwa.
Dholuo: Pesa ma itiyogo e timo nonro mar Covid-19 kod keto ji kar kendgi biro dhi ne sirkal chakre kawuono. Jo-Kenya ok onego oluor dhi e nonro

English: Announcement of multi-sector collaboration to support school nutrition and small-scale dairy livelihoods through public procurement.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la ushirikiano wa sekta mbalimbali ili kusaidia lishe shuleni na riziki ndogo za maziwa kupitia ununuzi wa umma.
Dholuo: Lando mar tudruok e kind migepe mopogore opogore mondo okony chiemo e skunde kod yore mag dak mar joma tiyo gi chak e okang' matin kokalo kuom chenro mar ng'iewo gik moko.

English: Combine applying organic manure with proper spacing to boost your groundnuts yield.
Kiswahili: Changanya kutumia mbolea ya asili na nafasi sahihi ili kuongeza mavuno ya karanga.
Dholuo: Riw keto lum ma dongo dongo kod thuolo mowinjore mondo omed cham mari mar njugu.

English: Response teams have been mobilized on the ground to reach the most affected communities.
Kiswahili: Timu za kukabiliana zimehamasishwa mashinani ili kufikia jamii zilizoathiriwa zaidi.
Dholuo: Osechoko jogo ma konyo e piny mondo gichop e gwenge ma oyudo masira ahinya.

English: You can now apply for birth certificate registration online through the eCitizen portal.
Kiswahili: Sasa unaweza kuomba usajili wa cheti cha kuzaliwa mtandaoni kupitia mfumo wa eCitizen.
Dholuo: Koro inyalo ndiko kwayo mar oboke mar nyuol e mbui kokalo e mbui mar eCitizen.

English: Half-time used for civic talks
Kiswahili: Nusu ya muda inayotumika kwa mazungumzo ya kiraia
Dholuo: Thuolo ma ne itiyo godo e goyo mbaka mag ji duto

English: Showcase corruption exposés that led to policy changes.
Kiswahili: Onyesha ufichuzi wa ufisadi uliosababisha mabadiliko ya sera.
Dholuo: Nyis kaka ne nitie mibadhi ma ne omiyo sirkal oloko chenro mopogore

English: Climate disasters increase risks of violence. Preparedness must include violence risk assessments and mitigation actions.
Kiswahili: Maafa ya hali ya hewa huongeza hatari za vurugu. Utayari lazima ujumuishe tathmini za hatari za vurugu na hatua za kupunguza athari.
Dholuo: Masira mabiro kaluwore gi lokruok yamo medo mahundu. Ikruok nyaka ng'I yore mag geng'o mahundu

English: The free sanitary products programme now covers learners at pre-primary school facing financial hardship.
Kiswahili: mpango wa taulo za bure sasa inahusisha wanafunzi katika shule ya chekechea wanaokabiliwa na ugumu wa kifedha.
Dholuo: Program mar gik mitiyogo e rito ler ma onge chudo sani oriwo jopuonjre ma ni e skul ma pok ochako somo ma yudo pek mag pesa.

English: You can now apply for passport application services online through the eCitizen portal.
Kiswahili: Sasa unaweza kuomba huduma za maombi ya pasipoti mtandaoni kupitia mfumo wa eCitizen.
Dholuo: Koro inyalo ndiko kwayo mar ote paspot e mbui kokalo e mbui mar eCitizen.

English: Parents should watch for dehydration in children and seek immunization services promptly.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanapaswa kuchunga upungufu wa maji mwilini kwa watoto na kutafuta huduma za chanjo haraka.
Dholuo: Jonyuol onego orit mondo kik pi otho e ringre nyithindo kendo onego giyud kony mar thieth mapiyo.

English: Residents attending anti-corruption awareness campaigns can also learn how to access voter registration updates on the spot.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wanaohudhuria kampeni za uhamasishaji dhidi ya ufisadi wanaweza pia kujifunza jinsi ya kupata masasisho ya usajili wa wapiga kura papo hapo.
Dholuo: Jodak ma dhi e kampen mag puonjo ji e wi tim mar ketho chik bende nyalo ng'eyo kaka ginyalo yudo weche ma manyien mag ndiko nying' jogo ma dhi goyo ombulu e kanyo.

English: Learn more about managing chronic illness by visiting your community health worker.
Kiswahili: Jifunze zaidi kuhusu usimamizi wa magonjwa sugu kwa kutembelea mhudumu wa afya wa jamii yako.
Dholuo: Ng'e mathoth kuom rito tuoche ma ok rum kuom dhi limo jatich mar thieth e alworau.

English: Develop assessment rubrics 2022.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza rubriki za tathmini 2022.
Dholuo: Loso chenro mag nonro mar 2022.

English: During disease outbreaks, always keep emergency contacts on hand in case of strong winds.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa milipuko ya magonjwa, weka nambari za dharura karibu endapo kutakuwa na upepo mkali.
Dholuo: E kinde ma tuoche pong'o piny, kinde duto bed gi jogo ma inyalo tudruokgo mapiyo ka yamo matek owuok.

English: Fuel your body, feed your mind! What you eat, how you move, and what you avoid directly shapes your mental health. Choose clean eating, stay active, and say NO to harmful substances. Your future self will thank you!
Kiswahili: Tia nguvu mwili wako, lisha akili yako! Kile unachokula, jinsi unavyotembea, na kile unachoepuka huunda moja kwa moja afya yako ya akili. Chagua kula safi, endelea kufanya mazoezi, na useme HAPANA kwa vitu vyenye madhara. Utu wako wa baadaye utakushukuru!
Dholuo: Bed ni en parruok, parruok mang'eny, parruok, kata mana winjo ka chunyi onyosore ahinya, parruok nyalo ketho pach ng'ato. Wuo gi osiepni migeno, kata ng'at moro manyalo konyi gi paro. Kwayo kony en gima nyiso ni ng'ato nigi teko, to ok ni ng'ato oloyo nyawadgi.

English: Basic Education Statistical Booklet 2020 released.
Kiswahili: Kijitabu cha Takwimu za Elimu ya Msingi 2020 kimetolewa.
Dholuo: Buk mar Basic Education Statistical Booklet 2020 ne ogol.

English: Keep an emergency contact list on the fridge and with your older children.
Kiswahili: Weka orodha ya mawasiliano ya dharura kwenye friji na pamoja na watoto wako wakubwa.
Dholuo: Ket weche ma nyalo konyi e simo kendo ikri gi nyithindi madongo.

English: Make sure employees are aware of resources available to them, such as Employee Assistance Programs (EAPs), mental health hotlines, or counseling services
Kiswahili: Hakikisha wafanyakazi wanafahamu rasilimali zinazopatikana kwao, kama vile Programu za Usaidizi kwa Wafanyakazi (EAPs), simu za dharura za afya ya akili, au huduma za ushauri nasaha.
Dholuo: Par ane kony ma inyalo yudo kuom lakteche. Lakteche nyalo konyi ng'eyo kaka inyalo nyagori gi paro ma ok owinjore ma ji nigo kuomi kendo ginyalo konyi bedo gi paro mowinjore kuomi

English: School records full transition to high school, expands vocational training.
Kiswahili: Shule inarekodi mpito kamili hadi shule ya upili, inapanua mafunzo ya ufundi.
Dholuo: Skundego chiwo thuolo mondo nyithindo odonj e skunde mamalo, kendo gipuonjogi tije mopogore opogore.

English: Kenya and Indonesia held a Nairobi–Mombasa workshop to share community based approaches and draft a memorandum of understanding on PCVE collaboration.
Kiswahili: Kenya na Indonesia zilifanya warsha ya Nairobi-Mombasa ili kushiriki mbinu zinazotegemea jamii na kuandaa hati ya makubaliano kuhusu ushirikiano wa PCVE.
Dholuo: Kenya gi Indonesia ne otimo chokruok mar Nairobi - Mombasa mondo gipog paro ma ji nigo e wi gik ma gitimo kendo gichop e wi winjruok e wi tich ma gitiyogo e PCVE.

English: Protect your rice from locusts by planting drought-resistant varieties.
Kiswahili: Linda mchele yako dhidi ya nzige kwa kupanda aina zinazostahimili ukame.
Dholuo: Rit mzabibu mari kuom winyo kuom pidho kit mzabibu ma ok nyal geng'o oro.

English: Mobile health services in Kenya reduce the risk of stillbirths
Kiswahili: Huduma za afya kwa njia ya simu nchini Kenya hupunguza hatari ya watoto kuzaliwa wakiwa wamekufa
Dholuo: Tich mag thieth ma wuotho ​​e piny Kenya dwoko piny nyalo mar nyuol nyithindo ma osetho

English: Visit your nearest agricultural office to learn about agroforestry.
Kiswahili: Tembelea ofisi ya kilimo ya karibu kujifunza kuhusu kilimo mseto.
Dholuo: Dhi e ofis mar pur man machiegni kodi mondo ing'e weche mag pur.

English: To reduce electoral malpractice, the county is expanding access to land title services this year.
Kiswahili: Ili kupunguza udanganyifu wa uchaguzi, kaunti inapanua upatikanaji wa huduma za hati za ardhi mwaka huu.
Dholuo: Mondo ogeng' tim marach mag yiero, kauntino medo ng'ado bura kuom ng'ado bura mar yudo oboke mag piny e higa ni.

English: To fight delayed government services, the county is promoting county budget consultations alongside easier access to business permit applications.
Kiswahili: Ili kupambana na huduma za serikali kuchelewa, kaunti inahamasisha mashauriano ya bajeti ya kaunti pamoja na upatikanaji rahisi wa maombi ya leseni za biashara.
Dholuo: Mondo oked gi tich ma sirkal timo ma dero, kauntino kelo paro mag bajet mar kaunti kaachiel gi yudo mayot mar kwayo oboke mar timo ohala.

English: UoN report assesses trust dynamics and communication as key to successful COP in Ruai portion of Nairobi
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya UoN inatathmini mienendo ya uaminifu na mawasiliano kama ufunguo wa COP iliyofanikiwa katika sehemu ya Ruai jijini Nairobi
Dholuo: Ripot mar UN nono dongruok mar geno kod tudruok kaka gima duong' e miyo COP odhi maber e Ruai ma Nairobi

English: EACC is investigating individuals posing as ministry auditors soliciting bribes from small schools. All inspections are officially scheduled and documented
Kiswahili: EACC inachunguza watu wanaojifanya wakaguzi wa wizara wanaoomba rushwa kutoka shule ndogo. Ukaguzi wote umepangwa rasmi na kuandikwa.
Dholuo: EACC nono joma nyiso ni gin jorit-tinda mag sirkal kendo manyo asoya e skunde matindo.

English: Listeners win airtime by answering civic questions
Kiswahili: Wasikilizaji hushinda muda wa matangazo kwa kujibu maswali ya kiraia
Dholuo: Jowinjo yudo thuolo mar chiwo dwoko e wi penjo ma ji penjo

English: Keep your sheep healthy by monitoring for signs of lumpy skin disease.
Kiswahili: Weka kondoo wako na afya kwa kuchunguza dalili za ugonjwa wa ngozi ya uvimbe.
Dholuo: Ket rombe magi obed gi ngima maber kuom luwo ranyisi mag tuoche mag del ma nigi lumpy.

English: Plan feed supplies to avoid shortages. Preserve fodder and use drought-resistant varieties.
Kiswahili: Panga vifaa vya kulisha ili kuepuka uhaba. Hifadhi malisho na tumia aina zinazostahimili ukame.
Dholuo: Tim chenro mar kungo chiemo mondo kik chiaye bed kech

English: Human activities cause most wildfires. Avoid open flames in forests and report smoke sightings to Kenya Forest Service.
Kiswahili: Shughuli za kibinadamu husababisha moto mwingi wa porini. Epuka miale ya moto iliyo wazi katika misitu na uripoti moshi kwa Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya.
Dholuo: Timbe mag dhano ema kelo mach mang'eny e bunge. Tem kik ichwe mach e bunge kendo iter ripot ne Kenya Forest Service ka ineno iro e bungu

English: Communications Authority warns of cloned betting apps circulating on Telegram. Many steal your phone data and banking information
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano yaonya kuhusu programu za kamari zilizotengenezwa kwa njia ya kloni zinazosambaa kwenye Telegram. Nyingi huiba data ya simu yako na taarifa za benki
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Weche Loso Wacho e Wi Weche mag Intanet, chiwo siem ni nitie program mag goyo tuke mag loyo mich kuom hawi ma yudore e Telegram.

English: The event, held at Gilgil Stadium, was streamed live on KDF platforms to promote transparency and educate the public on the recruitment process.
Kiswahili: Hafla hiyo, iliyofanyika katika Uwanja wa Gilgil, ilirushwa moja kwa moja kwenye majukwaa ya KDF ili kukuza uwazi na kuelimisha umma kuhusu mchakato wa kuajiri.
Dholuo: Chokruogno mane otim e paw tuke mar Gilgil, ne oter e yamo e ndiri mag jolweny mag KDF mondo omi ji ong'e weche duto elela kendo gipuonj ji weche momedore e wi chenro mar ndikruok.

English: Delay bathing a newborn for at least 24 hours to protect the skin's natural defenses.
Kiswahili: Chelewesha kumwogesha mtoto mchanga kwa angalau saa 24 ili kulinda kinga asilia za ngozi.
Dholuo: Ket thuolo moromo ne nyathi ma eka oa nyuol mondo oyud pi kuom seche 24, mondo omi orit ringre.

English: Apply for the orphan and vulnerable children fund to help with your child's school fees.
Kiswahili: Omba mfuko wa watoto yatima na walio hatarini kusaidia ada ya shule ya mtoto wako.
Dholuo: Kwayo pesa mar nyithindo ma nigi jonyuol ma onge jonyuol kod ma nigi pek mondo okonyi chulo skul mar nyathini.

English: Bridge the gap! Provide digital tools for disabled students.
Kiswahili: Ziba pengo! Toa zana za kidijitali kwa wanafunzi walemavu.
Dholuo: Beduru motang'! Chiw ne jopuonjre ma nigi midekre gige timo nonro mag kompyuta.

English: Farmers growing maize are advised to watch out for coffee berry disease this season.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanaolima mahindi washauriwa kuchunga ugonjwa wa chungu wa kahawa msimu huu.
Dholuo: Jopur mapidho cham omiye rieko mondo kik giyud tuoche mag berry mag kahawa e kindeni.

English: PRWG urged police to prevent masked infiltrators during protests, maintain professional crowd control, and ensure accountability for misconduct.
Kiswahili: PRWG iliwasihi polisi kuzuia wavamizi waliovaa barakoa wakati wa maandamano, kudumisha udhibiti wa kitaalamu wa umati, na kuhakikisha uwajibikaji kwa utovu wa nidhamu.
Dholuo: PRWG ne ojiwo polise mondo ogeng' joma donjo e timbe mag wuondo, kendo mondo gichak rito oganda mar ji, kendo mondo gimi ji duto obed gi ketho kuom timbe maricho.

English: African Anti‑Corruption Day 2025 urged united action against abuses of human dignity.
Kiswahili: Siku ya Kupambana na Rushwa ya Afrika 2025 ilihimiza hatua za pamoja dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa utu wa binadamu.
Dholuo: Odiechieng' mar kedo gi mibadhi e Afrika 2025 ne ojiwo ni mondo otim kinda e kedo gi timbe maricho mag ketho nying dhano.

English: If you have information, #ReachDCI through hotline number 0800 722 203. Let's work together to uphold justice and accountability. #FichuaGaitho
Kiswahili: Kama una taarifa, #Wasiliana naDCI kupitia nambari ya simu 0800 722 203. Tushirikiane kudumisha haki na uwajibikaji. #FichuaGaitho
Dholuo: Ka in gi weche, tudri gi #ReachDCI e simo mar 0800 722 203. We wati kanyachiel mondo warit ratiro kod bura. #FichuaGaitho

English: Keep your dairy cows healthy by monitoring for signs of foot-and-mouth disease.
Kiswahili: Weka ng'ombe wa maziwa wako na afya kwa kuchunguza dalili za ugonjwa wa miguu na midomo.
Dholuo: Ket dhiang' magi ma chak obed gi ngima maber kuom luwo ranyisi mag tuoche mag tielo kod dhok.

English: The free sanitary products programme now covers learners at Early Childhood Development Education facing financial hardship.
Kiswahili: mpango wa taulo za bure sasa inahusisha wanafunzi katika elimu ya awali wanaokabiliwa na ugumu wa kifedha.
Dholuo: Program mar gik ma itiyogo e rito ler ma onge chudo sani oriwo jopuonjre e somo mar dongruok mar nyithindo matindo ma yudo pek mag pesa.

English: Officials encourage citizens to combine anti-corruption awareness campaigns participation with awareness of the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Maafisa wanahimiza wananchi kuchanganya ushiriki katika kampeni za uhamasishaji dhidi ya ufisadi na uelewa wa nafasi ya mdhibiti malalamiko.
Dholuo: Jotelo jiwo jodak mondo oket kanyakla bedo e kampen mag puonjo ji e wi ketho chik kod ng'eyo tich ma jatend piny onego otim.

English: Communities facing lightning strikes should follow school safety protocols issued by county disaster teams.
Kiswahili: Jamii zinazokabiliwa na mapigo ya radi zinapaswa kufuata kanuni za usalama shuleni zilizotolewa na timu za maafa za kaunti.
Dholuo: Jodak ma yudo masira mag mil polo onego oluw chike mag arita mag skul ma ogol gi jokanyo mag masira mag kaunti.

English: Vaccinate your dairy cows against African swine fever before the rainy season.
Kiswahili: Chanja ng'ombe wa maziwa yako dhidi ya homa ya nguruwe ya Afrika kabla ya msimu wa mvua.
Dholuo: Chiw chanjo ne dhiang' mari mamiyo chak mar tuo mar ng'ombe ma Afrika kapok kinde koth ochopo.

English: Use security cameras with cloud storage to preserve evidence if needed.
Kiswahili: Tumia kamera za usalama zenye hifadhi ya wingu ili kuhifadhi ushahidi inapohitajika.
Dholuo: Ti gi kamera mag sirkal ma nigi kuonde ma inyalo kano gik moko e boche polo mondo iket gik ma nyiso ni gimoro otimore.

English: During fire disasters, always keep emergency contacts on hand in case of landslides.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa majanga ya moto, weka nambari za dharura karibu endapo kutakuwa na maporomoko ya ardhi.
Dholuo: E kinde mag masira mag mach, kinde duto bed gi jogo ma inyalo tudruokgo mapiyo ka piny otur.
